hypotheses.B0_native_gate_patch_is_exact: Patching the native Block-2 gate reproduces logits and the final answer coordinates at fidelity at least 0.9999 everywhere.
hypotheses.B1_rank64_block2_gate_is_sufficient: Discovery PCA rank 64 reaches at least 0.80 selected held-out-template effect fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.B2_rank16_block2_gate_is_insufficient: Rank 16 remains below 0.80 selected held-out-template fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.B3_dense_block2_axes_beat_native_coordin: Rank-64 PCA exceeds the top-64 native coordinate affine subspace by at least 0.15 selected fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.B4_block2_pca_beats_random_subspaces: Rank-64 PCA exceeds the 95th percentile of 20 random rank-64 subspaces by at least 0.15 in every run and status.
hypotheses.B5_arbitrary_block2_code_is_broader: Selected rank-32 fidelity is at least 0.05 below unselected rank-32 fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.B6_block2_answer_centroids_are_not_a_suf: The oracle Block-2 answer-centroid span remains below 0.60 selected effect fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.B7_block2_subspace_predicts_final_answer: Rank-64 PCA reaches final answer-coordinate R-squared at least 0.70 on selected facts in every run.
hypotheses.B8_template_transfer_is_stable: Selected rank-64 effect fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates in every run.
hypotheses.B9_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
